important_instructions: Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year; all future communication will be through website, email, or SMS alerts only. content_sections.heading: BHEL Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates searching for the BHEL Apprentice apply online date and last date should note that all three categories share the same schedule.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Apprentice Vacancy 2026-27
content_sections.text: BHEL has notified 530 apprenticeship posts across three categories. The vacancy numbers are tentative and may increase or decrease at the discretion of BHEL management.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 varies by category, but preference across all three goes to candidates from Tamil Nadu institutions. Only candidates who completed their qualifying course (Degree/Diploma/ITI) in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible; qualifications via Distance Learning, Part-Time, Correspondence, or Sandwich courses are not considered. Candidates already undergoing or having completed apprenticeship elsewhere under the applicable Apprentices Act, or with one year or more of work experience, are not eligible. Graduate Apprentice applicants who hold a postgraduate qualification (including an integrated PG course) are also not eligible, as per the NATS process manual.

rows.qualification: 10+2 and full-time graduation in the relevant discipline (Engineering/Technology, B.Com for Accountant, B.A for Assistant-HR) from a Government recognized institution
High School pass and full-time Diploma in Engineering from a Government recognized institute, completed in the last 5 years
High School pass and full-time ITI pass from an NCVT/SCVT recognized institute (NCVT only for Welder trade)

content_sections.heading: BHEL Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is common across all three categories: minimum 18 years and maximum 27 years, as on 1 August 2026, for General category candidates. SC/ST candidates: 5 years' relaxation in the upper age limit OBC (NCL) candidates: 3 years' relaxation in the upper age limit Physically Challenged persons (minimum 40% disability): 10 years' relaxation in the upper age limit To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on fulfilling the conditions specified in the respective notification. A merit list is drawn based on marks secured in the qualifying examination (Degree/Diploma/ITI marks, as applicable). In case of a tie in marks, the candidate older in age is preferred. Selected candidates must meet the minimum physical fitness standards under Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and any amendments. No TA/DA is paid for certificate verification or for joining the training upon selection. Out of the training vacancies in each category, 19% is reserved for SC, 1% for ST, 27% for OBC (NCL), 10% for EWS, and 4% for Physically Challenged candidates. Reservation for dependents of regular BHEL employees (serving, retired, or deceased) is governed as per company rules. A post-wise or trade-wise numeric breakdown of these reserved seats is not specified in the notifications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27
content_sections.text: Register on the MHRD NATS 2.0 New Portal at nats.education.gov.in and note the 12/16-digit Student Enrolment Number. Apply online on the BHEL Trichy portal at trichy.bhel.com, via the "Apprenticeship Application Portal (TRICHY)" link, using the NATS enrolment number. Register on the BHEL portal, verify via OTP, and create a password. Log in, fill the application form, and upload all required documents. Submit the application and retain a copy for Document Verification. Register on the RDSDE (NAPS) Portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and note the 10-digit RDSDE (NAPS) registration number. Complete mandatory Aadhaar verification and e-KYC, ensuring name, date of birth, and gender match the SSLC certificate. Apply online on the BHEL Trichy portal at trichy.bhel.com using the RDSDE (NAPS) registration number. Register on the BHEL portal, verify via OTP, create a password, log in, and fill the application form. Upload all required documents and submit; retain a copy for Document Verification. Only the online mode of application is accepted; applications received in any other mode or form will be treated as rejected.

content_sections.text: Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year; all future communication will be through website, email, or SMS alerts only. Canvassing in any form will render the candidate ineligible. Preference is given to candidates who passed their qualifying exam from Government recognized institutions in Tamil Nadu; other candidates are considered only if Tamil Nadu candidates are unavailable for a notified branch. Upon completion of the apprenticeship, BHEL has no obligation to offer employment, nor can an apprentice claim any right to employment on that ground. Further updates on eligible candidate lists and document verification will be published only on trichy.bhel.com or via email; candidates should check regularly.

faq.question: Q1. What is BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a set of three circulars from BHEL Tiruchirappalli for engaging apprentices for 2026-27 - Graduate Apprentice, Technician Apprentice, and Trade Apprentice - totalling 530 one-year training vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: 530 total: Graduate Apprentice (90), Technician Apprentice (60), and Trade Apprentice (380).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 12 September 2026 at 23:45 Hrs for all three categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A relevant Degree for Graduate Apprentice, a Diploma in Engineering for Technician Apprentice, and an ITI pass (NCVT/SCVT) for Trade Apprentice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: 18 to 27 years as on 1 August 2026 for General candidates, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), and Physically Challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: ₹12,300/month for Graduate Apprentice, ₹10,900/month for Technician Apprentice, and ₹10,560–₹11,040/month for Trade Apprentice depending on the trade.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: By first registering on the applicable Government portal (NATS 2.0 for Graduate/Technician, RDSDE-NAPS for Trade), then applying on the BHEL Trichy portal, trichy.bhel.com.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BHEL Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A merit list based on qualifying-exam marks; ties are resolved in favour of the older candidate.
